title: C-SafeGen: Certified Safe LLM Generation with Claim-Based Streaming Guardrails
abstract: arXiv:2610.34961v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite the remarkable capabilities of large language models (LLMs) across diverse applications, they remain vulnerable to generating content that violates safety regulations and policies. To mitigate these risks, LLMs undergo safety alignment; however, they can still be effectively jailbroken. Off-the-shelf guardrail models are commonly deployed to monitor generations, but these models primarily focus on detection rather than ensuring safe decoding of LLM outputs. Moreover, existing efforts lack rigorous safety guarantees, which are crucial for the universal deployment of LLMs and certifiable compliance with regulatory standards. In this paper, we propose a Claim-based Stream Decoding (CSD) algorithm coupled with a statistical risk guarantee framework using conformal analysis. translated_abstract: 尽管大语言模型（LLMs）在各类应用中展现出卓越能力，但它们仍然容易生成违反安全法规和政策的内容。为了缓解这些风险，LLMs 会经过安全对齐训练；然而，它们仍可能被有效越狱。现成的护栏模型通常被部署用于监控生成内容，但这些模型主要侧重于检测，而非确保 LLM 输出的安全解码。此外，现有工作缺乏严格的安全保证，而这对 LLM 的普遍部署以及可认证的监管标准合规至关重要。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于声明的流式解码算法，并结合了基于保形分析的统计风险保证框架。具体而言，我们的 CSD 算法集成了一个流式护栏模型来保护 LLM 生成的顺序声明，并引入了回溯机制来
tldr: 该论文提出了基于声明的流式解码（CSD）算法，结合保形分析提供统计风险保证框架，通过流式护栏模型与回溯机制为 LLM 生成内容提供可认证的安全保障。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a Claim-based Stream Decoding (CSD) algorithm coupled with a statistical risk guarantee framework based on conformal analysis, providing certified safety assurance for LLM generation through a stream guardrail model and backtracking mechanism.
